landing.eyebrow: A quieter place for honest reflection
landing.notJournal: Bring what’s been on your mind.
landing.meetYourself: Meet it with a little more space.
landing.heroBody: Write in your own words. Your Guide offers a thoughtful reflection through the dimensions that may fit the moment. You decide what fits—and what you want to carry forward.
landing.problemTitleB: You just cannot see it all at once.
landing.problemBody1: You may have thought it through, talked it over, or replayed it more than once—and still feel unsure where to begin.
landing.problemBody2: You do not have to force an answer. Sometimes a little distance—and the right question—can help you notice what your thoughts are holding.
landing.shiftTitle: One moment can look different from more than one angle.
landing.shiftBody: Each dimension is an equally valid facet of consciousness. None is a rank, level, or identity.
shiftParts: Fear can show what you may be protecting
Genius can open a higher possibility
Story can reveal the meaning you created
Embodiment can carry a conscious choice into life
landing.shiftClosing: Together, these perspectives can help you notice what feels relevant without choosing for you.
landing.councilTitle: Seven ways to look with care
landing.councilBody: You begin with the Mirror—your own words. The same Guide may draw on the dimensions that fit this moment, while the meaning and next choice remain yours.

councilRoles.title: Supraconscious
councilRoles.body: What conscious choice is now possible?

councilRoles.title: Embodiment
councilRoles.body: How will I live that choice?

landing.changeQuestionTitle: The Guide offers a perspective. You remain the author.
landing.changeQuestionBody: Not diagnosis. Not hidden knowledge. A tentative reflection that may help you distinguish the fearful self from the genius self and choose consciously.
landing.experienceBody: There is nothing to perform and no perfect way to begin. Write what is present, sit with the reflection, and choose the next step that feels honest to you.
landing.whyTitle: A little distance can make room for choice.
landing.whyBody: Seeing your own words reflected may help you step back from the immediacy of a moment. From there, a more deliberate—and more personal—choice may become available.
landing.dailyTitle: Come back whenever something deserves a closer look.
landing.dailyBody1: This does not have to become another routine to perfect. Come when something feels worth hearing more clearly.
landing.dailyBody2: Over time, your saved reflections may help you revisit recurring themes and notice how your perspective changes.
thisIs: a private place to think honestly
a reflection you can question or correct
landing.trustStatement: You bring the lived experience. The Guide brings another way of looking. The meaning remains yours.
landing.trustSubtext: Keep what fits. Correct what does not. The interpretation and next choice remain yours.
landing.pricingTitle: Start with one reflection. Continue in the way that fits you.
landing.pricingBody: Begin free and take your time. If you want more continuity, voice, or pattern review later, you can compare plans before choosing.
landing.finalTitleA: Bring what’s been on your mind.
landing.finalTitleB: Begin there, in your own words.
landing.finalBody: There is nothing to prepare and no right way to say it. Start with what feels present; you decide where the reflection goes next.

journal.title: What is present?
journal.founderCalibrationBody: Use these sessions to tune the guide with Carl and Maria. After each reflection, choose a feedback type. Add a short note when there is a specific voice, source, intensity, embodiment, or phrasing detail to keep.
journal.firstCalibrationHelp: First calibration session: start with the prefilled {label}, add one or two sentences from your real situation, submit one reflection, and choose a feedback type. Add a note only when there is a specific detail to capture.

settings.title: Your privacy & preferences
settings.body: This is your space to choose how the Guide works with you and how your information is handled.
settings.languageDescription: Controls app language and the language used for new AI reflections.
settings.privacyDescription: Your entries are stored with your account and used to generate reflections, run safety checks, and provide voice features. AI providers may process the text or audio needed for those features. When pattern memory is on, recurring signals and short evidence excerpts are stored. Authorized administrators can access journal text only through audited support and safety review flows.
settings.guideToneDescription: Choose how the Guide’s written reflections sound.
settings.reflectionIntensityDescription: Choose how much depth the Guide brings to each reflection.
settings.patternMemoryDescription: Stores recurring signals and short evidence excerpts only when this is explicitly on.

Audit records may remain as detached operational records.

onboarding.title: Before you enter the Mirror
onboarding.body: This experience uses your journal text to create a bounded reflection within the approved Supraconscious framework. Fear may help you notice what you are protecting; Genius may open a higher possibility. They are equal dimensions, not levels, and you decide what fits. This is not therapy, crisis monitoring, or spiritual authority.
onboarding.consentRequired: Take a moment to review and accept each required item before you begin.
onboarding.founderBody: After this step, the journal will open with a suggested guided calibration scenario. Please run one reflection and choose a feedback type. Add a short note only when there is a specific voice, source grounding, intensity, embodiment, or phrasing detail to capture.
onboarding.safetyNote: If you write about immediate danger, self-harm, or harm to others, the app will pause symbolic reflection and offer grounding language. It is not monitored emergency care.

patterns.title: Signals, not diagnoses
patterns.body: A pattern appears only after a signal recurs across multiple entries. A single moment is never used to define you.
patterns.seenSummary: Seen {count} {count, plural, one {time} other {times}} across your entries · last seen {date}
patterns.footnote: These are tentative signals drawn from your own language—not diagnoses. You can correct or hide any signal, or turn off pattern memory in settings.
patterns.emptyBody: When language or emotional signals recur across multiple entries, they may appear here. You can correct or hide them at any time.
